description: Source code for MAX31855 thermocouple-to-digital converter driver, including SPI communication, temperature reading, and error handling.

methods.name: showEgtInfo
methods.description: Displays SPI configuration and channel info for EGT sensors.

methods.name: getMcCode
methods.description: Returns string description of error code based on MAX31855 packet status.

methods.name: getResultCode
methods.description: Interprets MAX31855 packet bits to determine sensor status or errors.

methods.name: readEgtPacket
methods.description: Reads a data packet from the MAX31855 sensor over SPI.

methods.name: getEgtValue
methods.description: Returns the temperature value from the MAX31855 sensor or error code.

methods.name: egtRead
methods.description: Reads and logs EGT temperature data from the sensor.

methods.name: initMax31855
methods.description: Initializes the MAX31855 driver, SPI configuration, and console commands.
